FROM "LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR"
JOIN "LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL" ON "LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR"."LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY" = "LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL"."LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY"

JOIN "LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED" ON "ACADEMIC_TERMS"."TERM_CODE" = "LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED"."TERM_CODE"

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, VARIANCE(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, catalog_key_variance, term_sort FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(DEPARTMENT) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE DEPARTMENT END AS dept_sort, DEPARTMENT AS dept, VARIANCE(LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS catalog_key_variance FROM (SELECT lci.DEPARTMENT, lrmd.TERM_CODE, lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY FROM `LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR` AS lci JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrmd ON lci.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS base GROUP BY TERM_CODE, DEPARTMENT WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS` JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(stddev_total_units) AS stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), DepartmentsWithHighVariance AS (SELECT DISTINCT dept FROM Subquery1 WHERE NOT catalog_key_variance IS NULL) SELECT s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM Subquery2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME IN (SELECT dept FROM DepartmentsWithHighVariance) ORDER BY s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `TIP_DETAIL` AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 20) SELECT ic.department_name, ic.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students, ROUND(ic.total_reserved_materials / NULLIF(cs.max_enrolled_students, 0), 2) AS reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') AS cs ON ic.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY reserved_materials_per_max_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT department, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY department), subq1 AS (SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'WITHIN_10_PERCENT' END AS subject_count_category FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.department = d.department), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, STDDEV(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_total_units FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), subq2 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, avg_total_units, stddev_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso2.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM `ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL` AS ata2 JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso2 ON ata2.TERM_CODE = ccso2.TERM_CODE WHERE ata2.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ata2.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%')) SELECT s1.department, s1.academic_year, s1.subject_count, s1.min_term_start_date, s1.avg_subject_count, s1.subject_count_category, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s2.avg_total_units, s2.stddev_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.academic_year = s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY s1.department, s1.academic_year

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte2 JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.total_enrolled, s1.num_unique_subjects, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccc.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND ccc.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2007' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY scd.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), cte1 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY END AS SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, CASE WHEN GROUPING(COURSE) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE COURSE END AS COURSE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count, SUM(total_units) AS total_units FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, COURSE WITH ROLLUP HAVING SUM(subject_count) > 0), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Non-MIT') AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 1000), cte2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS num_courses_latest_year FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS c ON s.SUBJECT_CODE = c.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) FROM `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG`) GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_units) SELECT cte1.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY, cte1.COURSE, cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.subject_count, cte1.total_units, cte2.total_units AS dept_total_units, cte2.num_courses_latest_year FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cte1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte1.SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(reserved_count) AS avg_reserved_materials FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso LEFT JOIN (SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_count FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL` AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) AS reserves ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = reserves.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND NOT tso.TERM_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY tso.TERM_CODE, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(term) OVER (ORDER BY term_sort, term, dept_sort) = term THEN NULL ELSE term END AS term, dept, num_chemistry_courses, avg_reserved_materials, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS department_full_name FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE TERM_CODE END AS term, CASE WHEN GROUPING(TERM_CODE) = 0 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE department_name END AS dept_sort, department_name AS dept, SUM(num_chemistry_courses) AS num_chemistry_courses, AVG(avg_reserved_materials) AS avg_reserved_materials, MAX(OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS offer_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE, department_name, OFFER_DEPT_CODE WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp LEFT JOIN `STUDENT_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tbltmp.offer_dept_code = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY term_sort, dept_sort
